newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end up on funds shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end up on funds shortage.

text.p: Pakistani money rates closed higher on Monday amid tight liquidity and were likely to open up on Tuesday as no major inflows or outflows were expected, dealers said.
Overnight funds were initially traded at around 17.5 percent to 18 percent, but soon heavy borrowing pressure jacked rates up to 19.5 percent, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
He said most deals near the close were done at that level. The market closed short and borrowers had to approach the central bank's discount window to square their positions.
